title: Me
description: This endpoint provides a way to test authentication with an API key. The API returns identifying information corresponding to the provided authentication method. This endpoint does not accept any parameters ### Response Headers * **Retry-After**: A numerical value in seconds is returned when the status code returned is 429. This indicates the number of seconds after which the request may be retried. ### Role Mappings The `role` field in the response maps to API key permission levels as follows: | Role Value | Permission Level | |---|---| | `USER` | Standard | | `ARCHITECT` | Architect | | `ADMIN` | Admin | ### Additional Information * [Authentication](../../authentication/getting-started)

orgId.description: The Org Id corresponding to the authenticated API key

embedPartnerId.description: The Embed Partner Id corresponding to the authenticated API key

email.description: The email corresponding to the authenticated seat. This will be blank if the request used the legacy org key instead of a per-user key.

clientId.description: The email corresponding to the authenticated seat. This will be blank if the request used the legacy org key instead of a per-user key.

role.description: The Role associated with the api key
role.title: string

scopes.description: The Scopes associated with the access token
scopes.title: string
